ext-msa-01-en-long
SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NO LEGAL ADVICE
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
Between Vertex Lumen Corp. and Orchard Signal Ltd.
Effective date: 1 July 2025.
Initial term: three (3) years.
The Parties perform their obligations in good faith and cooperate with each other.
Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the interpretation of this
Agreement.
Synthetic fixture; no legal advice | LegalDesk Phase 14
ext-msa-01-en-long
1. Definitions. Services means the services described in each work order. Fees means
the amounts payable under Section 3.
Nothing in this Agreement limits liability for fraud or wilful misconduct.
Each Party complies with the laws that apply to its own activities under this
Agreement. Notices are given in writing at the address that each Party has
communicated to the other. No failure or delay in exercising a right is a waiver of
that right.
Synthetic fixture; no legal advice | LegalDesk Phase 14
ext-msa-01-en-long
3. Services and fees. The Supplier provides the Services described in each work order.
The monthly fee is USD 18,000, invoiced in advance on the first day of each month.
No failure or delay in exercising a right is a waiver of that right. If a provision is
held to be invalid, the remaining provisions continue in full force. This Agreement is
amended only by a written document signed by both Parties.
Synthetic fixture; no legal advice | LegalDesk Phase 14
ext-msa-01-en-long
4. Payment. Undisputed invoices are payable within forty-five (45) days of receipt.
Disputed amounts must be notified within ten (10) days of receipt of the invoice.
This Agreement is amended only by a written document signed by both Parties.
Assignment of this Agreement needs the prior written consent of the other Party. The
Parties are independent contractors and nothing here creates a partnership or an
agency.
Synthetic fixture; no legal advice | LegalDesk Phase 14
ext-msa-01-en-long
5. Confidentiality. Confidentiality obligations survive termination for seven (7)
years.
Each Party protects the other's confidential information with the care it uses for its
own.
The Parties are independent contractors and nothing here creates a partnership or an
agency. Schedules and annexes form part of this Agreement unless they say otherwise.
Synthetic fixture; no legal advice | LegalDesk Phase 14
ext-msa-01-en-long
6. Limitation of liability. Each Party's total liability is capped at the fees paid in
the twelve (12) months before the claim.
The cap does not apply to the matters listed in Section 1.
Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the interpretation of this
Agreement. Each Party complies with the laws that apply to its own activities under
this Agreement. Notices are given in writing at the address that each Party has
communicated to the other.
Synthetic fixture; no legal advice | LegalDesk Phase 14
ext-msa-01-en-long
7. Termination. Either Party may terminate for convenience on ninety (90) days'
written notice.
Either Party may terminate for cause if a material breach is not cured within thirty
(30) days.
Notices are given in writing at the address that each Party has communicated to the
other. No failure or delay in exercising a right is a waiver of that right.
Synthetic fixture; no legal advice | LegalDesk Phase 14
ext-msa-01-en-long
8. Governing law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.
Disputes are finally settled by arbitration seated in London.
If a provision is held to be invalid, the remaining provisions continue in full force.
This Agreement is amended only by a written document signed by both Parties.
Assignment of this Agreement needs the prior written consent of the other Party.
Synthetic fixture; no legal advice | LegalDesk Phase 14
ext-msa-01-en-long
9. Signatures. Signed by the authorised representatives of both Parties on the date
shown on the first page.
Assignment of this Agreement needs the prior written consent of the other Party. The
Parties are independent contractors and nothing here creates a partnership or an
agency. Schedules and annexes form part of this Agreement unless they say otherwise.
Synthetic fixture; no legal advice | LegalDesk Phase 14
